posts.title: [Advisory] Various WordPress Plugins: Critical RCE, SSRF and XSS
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full site control via arbitrary file uploads, while authenticated attackers can query internal systems or execute malicious scripts.
- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Forminator Forms (WPMU DEV)
- User Profile Builder
- Royal Elementor Addons (WP Royal)
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** For Forminator, the target site must have a form containing both a File Upload and a Select field. Royal Elementor flaws require Contributor-level access or higher.
- **Impact Details:** Forminator's flaw bypasses file extension blocklists via manipulated MIME types. Royal Elementor's flaws allow internal service querying and stored cross-site scripting via unvalidated widget settings.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor patches are available for both affected plugins.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-15748 CVSS3.1: 9.8 (CRITICAL) - Arbitrary file upload leading to unauthenticated remote code execution
- CVE-2026-15826 CVSS3.1: 9.8 (CRITICAL) - Authentication bypass allowing administrative takeover
- CVE-2026-17123 CVSS3.1: 8.8 (HIGH) - Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) allowing access to internal systems.
- CVE-2026-19217 CVSS3.1: 6.4 (MEDIUM) - Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) allowing arbitrary web script injection

posts.title: [Advisory] Citrix NetScaler: Unauthenticated memory disclosure when configured as SAML IDP (CVE-2026-8451, cve-2026-8452)
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to expose sensitive memory content via network requests to vulnerable appliances configured as SAML IDPs.
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited, Proof of Concept Available

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- NetScaler ADC
- NetScaler Gateway
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** NetScaler appliance must be configured to act as a SAML Identity Provider (SAML IDP).
- **Impact Details:** The XML parser fails to terminate unquoted attribute values followed by newlines, leading to an out-of-bounds read that leaks memory content in the NSC_TASS cookie.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor patches available
    - **Temporary:** Disable the SAML IDP configuration on the NetScaler appliance if immediate patching is not possible.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-8451 CVSS4.0: 8.8 (HIGH) - Out-of-bounds read in XML parser leading to unauthenticated memory exposure when configured as a SAML IDP.

##### REFERENCES:

Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://support.citrix.com/support-home/kbsearch/article?articleNumber=CTX696604

Supporting:
- Technical analysis / POC : https://labs.watchtowr.com/citrixbleed-to-infinity-and-beyond-citrix-netscaler-pre-auth-memory-overread-cve-2026-8451/
- News coverage: https://www.securityweek.com/new-citrixbleed-vulnerability-exploited-immediately-after-public-disclosure/

posts.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Patch Tuesday July 2026
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- **Current exploitation status**: Two vulnerabilities are listed as actively exploited and one as publicly disclosed.

##### NOTABLE CVEs

- [CVE-2026-56155](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-56155) - Active Directory Federation Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (Exploitation Detected)  
Insufficient granularity of access control in Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.      
An attacker with local access and low privileges who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain administrator privileges.   

- [CVE-2026-56164](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-56164) - Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (Exploitation Detected)   
Missing authentication for critical function in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.      
Successful exploitation allows an attacker to elevate privileges over a network, with no existing privileges required, and low attack complexity     

- [CVE-2026-50661](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-50661) Windows BitLocker Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability (Publicly disclosed)    
Protection mechanism failure in Windows BitLocker allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature with a physical attack.   

- [CVE-2026-55040](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/en-US/vulnerability/CVE-2026-55040) - Microsoft SharePoint Server Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability     
Weak authentication in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.    
The authentication feature could be bypassed as this vulnerability allows impersonation.    
Exploiting this vulnerability could allow an attacker to disclose files and modify data, but the attacker cannot impact the availability of the system.    
[Additional information](https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/ve-cve-2026-55040-microsoft-sharepoint-jwt-token-authentication-bypass-fixed/)

- [CVE-2026-50522](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-50522)/[CVE-2026-58644](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-58644) - Microsoft SharePoint Remote Code Execution Vulnerability      
Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.     
In a network-based attack, an attacker authenticated as at least a Site Owner, could write arbitrary code to inject and execute code remotely on the SharePoint Server.

- [CVE-2026-57092](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-57092) - Microsoft Windows VMSwitch Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability    
Use after free in Windows VMSwitch allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.   
An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could potentially gain elevated privileges on the host system beyond the guest virtual machine boundary.    

- [CVE-2026-55008](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-55008) - Microsoft Exchange Server Spoofing Vulnerability   
Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') in Microsoft Exchange Server allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.   
An attacker could exploit this issue by sending a specifically crafted malicious email to the user. If the user opens this email, in Outlook Web Access, and certain conditions are met, arbitrary execution of JavaScript would occur in the browser context.


##### REFERENCES:
Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/releaseNote/2026-Jul

Supporting:
- Additional Coverage: https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/em-patch-tuesday-july-2026/
- Additional Coverage: https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/blog/2026/7/14/the-july-2026-security-update-review
- CISA guidance on SharePoint hardening, related to active exploitation of recent Sharepoint CVEs: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/07/14/cisa-urges-sharepoint-hardening-after-new-exploitations

posts.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Patch Tuesday August 2026
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited (CVE-2026-68820)

##### NOTABLE CVEs:

[CVE-2026-68820](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-68820) Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (**Exploitation Detected**)   
Use after free in Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.     
Cybersecurity firm Check Point Research published [technical analysis](https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/shattering-the-dream-when-a-job-offer-becomes-a-zero-day-attack/) detailing exploitation of CVE-2026-68820.   


[CVE-2026-62832](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-62832) Windows User Profile Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (**Publicly disclosed**)   
Improper link resolution before file access ('link following') in Windows User Profile Service allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.  
An authenticated attacker who has credentials for another local account could run a specially crafted application to load another user's registry hive. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to access or modify another user's data and gain administrator privileges. User interaction is not required.    
CVE-2026-62832 is possibly related to the vulnerability dubbed [LegacyHive](https://security-hub.ncsc.admin.ch/#/posts/12622), that was publicly disclosed without a fix after July 2026 patch Tuesday.  

[CVE-2026-63520](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/en-US/vulnerability/CVE-2026-63520)
Improper input validation in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
This vulnerability is the second in an exploits chains that would lead to  an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in a vulnerable SharePoint server, the first vulnerability tracked as [CVE-2026-55040](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/en-US/vulnerability/CVE-2026-55040) fixed in [Micosoft's patch tuesday of July 2026](https://security-hub.ncsc.admin.ch/#/posts/12764).    
[Additional information](https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/etr-cve-2026-63520-microsoft-sharepoint-remote-code-execution-fixed/)    

[CVE-2026-62911](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-62911) Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability     
Authentication bypass by capture-replay in Microsoft Exchange Server allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.


##### REFERENCES:

- Source Advisory: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/releaseNote/2026-Aug

Supporting:

posts.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Power Pages misconfiguration exposes sensitive data
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Unauthenticated attackers can access and exfiltrate sensitive personal, financial, and organizational data from public-facing portals via exposed Dataverse tables.  
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Microsoft Power Pages  
- Microsoft Power Apps Portals

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** Public-facing Power Pages portal with "Anonymous Users" web role granted read permissions on sensitive Dataverse tables.  
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Microsoft provides configuration guidance to disable anonymous access and restrict table permissions.  
    - **Temporary:** Disable anonymous access, review table permissions, disable unnecessary Web API and OData feeds, and validate endpoint restrictions using an unauthenticated browser session.

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:  
- Source Advisory: [https://venarix.com/blog/exfilsquad-targets-misconfigured-microsoft-power-pages-portals](https://venarix.com/blog/exfilsquad-targets-misconfigured-microsoft-power-pages-portals)
- Mitigation Guidance: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/disable-anonymous-access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/disable-anonymous-access)


*Timestamp of the Information: 04.08.2026, 10:25*
posts.summary: A misconfiguration in Microsoft Power Pages portals has been actively exploited to exfiltrate sensitive data stored in Microsoft Dataverse. Microsoft Power Pages portals are vulnerable when the "Anonymous Users" web role is granted excessive read permissions on Dataverse tables, making the data publicly accessible to unauthenticated users.

posts.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Exchange: Arbitrary Code Execution via XSS (CVE-2026-42897)
posts.content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows attackers to execute arbitrary code in a victim's browser and perform network spoofing via malicious emails.
- **Current exploitation status**: Actively Exploited

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Microsoft Exchange Server
- Microsoft Exchange Server Subscription Edition (SE)
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** Attackers must send a specially crafted email, and the targeted user must open it in Outlook Web Access.
- **Impact Details:** Code executes in the user's browser context, which could allow attackers to bypass security boundaries, spoof content, or perform unauthorized actions.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Official full patches are currently pending or restricted to specific update programs.
    - **Temporary:** Enable the automated Exchange Emergency Mitigation Service (EEMS) or run the manual Exchange on-premises Mitigation Tool (EOMT) script.

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-42897 CVSS3.1: 8.1 (HIGH) - Cross-site scripting resulting in spoofing and arbitrary code execution

##### REFERENCES:

Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/microsoft/microsoft-warns-of-exchange-zero-day-flaw-exploited-in-attacks/
